extension.summary: curl_cffi: libcurl Python binding with Cloudflare impersonation support
extension.description:
curl_cffi 0.15.0 — libcurl Python binding that impersonates real browser TLS fingerprints (Chrome, Firefox, Safari) to bypass Cloudflare bot detection.
Platforms supported: - Windows x64 (Kodi 21 / Python 3.12, Kodi 22 / Python 3.13-3.14) - Android ARM64 (Kodi 22 / Python 3.13+)
Used by a4kScrapers when available, with automatic fallback to cloudscraper v1.2.60.
extension.news: v0.15.0 — Initial Kodi module build. Bundles Windows (cp312/cp313/cp314) and Android ARM64 binaries.
